name: godot-gamestudio
description: A supervised multi-agent studio loop for planning, building, reviewing, and verifying Godot games.

interface.shortDescription: Supervised Godot production with specialist review.
interface.longDescription: Plan and build Godot milestones with automatic specialist selection, independent reviewers, resumable project state, visual evidence, and supervisor acceptance gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $godot-gamestudio build to create this playable slice.
Use $godot-gamestudio review on the current milestone.
Use $godot-gamestudio status to assess project health.
